rows.note: This is the all-purpose equivalent for someone or something free from worries and cares.

example.english: After retiring, I live a carefree life.
example.traditional: 退休之後，我過住無憂無慮嘅生活。
example.jyutping: teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 gwo3 zyu6 mou4 jau1 mou4 leoi6 ge3 sang1 wut6

rows.note: Use this when “carefree” emphasizes feeling relaxed, unpressured, or free from difficulty rather than having no worries at all.

example.english: Today's work is light, so doing it feels carefree.
example.traditional: 今日啲工作唔多，做起上嚟好輕鬆。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 di1 gung1 zok3 m4 do1 zou6 hei2 soeng6 lai4 hou2 hing1 sung1

rows.note: Use this when a person is carefree because no responsibilities, attachments, or personal concerns are weighing on them.

example.english: Now that my children are grown, I'm carefree and can go wherever I want.
example.traditional: 仔女都大個，我而家無牽無掛，可以周圍去。
example.jyutping: zai2 neoi5 dou1 daai6 go3 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 mou4 hin1 mou4 gwaa3 ho2 ji5 zau1 wai4 heoi3
